scope: Local source audit and offline verification; existing uncommitted changes preserved

confirmedRootCauses.authoringRequests: AuthoringWorkflow.vue unconditionally scheduled GET /authoring every 2500 ms on mount and after every poll, regardless of job status. No watcher loop or AI scheduler was found.
confirmedRootCauses.fileSelectionDisplay: ImportMaterials.vue cleared the native file input after local extraction. The browser then displayed its empty-selection label. The old filename list relied only on IndexedDB recovery and did not identify selected versus uploaded files.

idleFrequency.before: One initial GET, then approximately 24 GET /authoring requests per minute per mounted workflow, derived from the 2500 ms timer; no live baseline test was run.
idleFrequency.after: One initial GET; zero periodic requests without queued/running jobs. Browser assertions observed zero requests during separate 5500 ms idle and completed-job windows.
idleFrequency.authorizedJobs: Poll at 2500 ms while queued/running. Stop at terminal status, unmount, or request error. Navigation does not cancel the backend job.
idleFrequency.crossTabChanges: Use Refresh progress to discover changes from other tabs while idle. Concurrent-save revision checks still protect edits.

geminiEvidence.attribution: The local QuizQuest ledger records these three successful provider responses. Matching them to the reported RPD increase, a specific job, or an initiating action is unconfirmed: historical events lack job context and the incident timestamp was not supplied. Token sizes alone do not establish the consumer or cause. Historical verification scripts also used this ledger.
geminiEvidence.getAuthoring: GET /api/teacher/courses/:cid/authoring only projects saved jobs. GET /authoring/:jid only reads saved analysis parts. Neither calls kick, start, resume, generateJson or Gemini indirectly.
geminiEvidence.saveReport: PUT /authoring/:jid/review validates revision, stores professor text and creates versioned report passages; it performs no inference.

invocationAudit.trigger: Authenticated professor POST authoring/report, recommendations, generation, explicit resume or draft regeneration
invocationAudit.details: Analysis may use multiple source groups and synthesis. Assessment generation includes drafting and independent verification; validation retries fill missing slots. No automatic restart recovery or GET-triggered inference.

invocationAudit.trigger: Authenticated professor POST /courses/:cid/generate or authoring generation
invocationAudit.details: Legacy generator already has an in-flight course lock, cache, daily drafting limit and bounded drafting rounds. Authoring additionally uses durable job deduplication and the lifetime Gemini request budget.

invocationAudit.trigger: Professor explicitly clicks Transcribe / Transcribe with AI
invocationAudit.details: Multimodal calls count tokens before inference. Each shared-client invocation has at most three transport attempts, at most six provider operations including recounting after fallback.

invocationAudit.trigger: Student submits a nonempty short answer through practice or Game
invocationAudit.details: One Gemini attempt, 15-second timeout, no quota wait, keyword fallback. Blank or expired answers are handled locally; idle timeout does not initiate inference.

invocationAudit.trigger: Teacher explicitly clicks Hero Lab AI test
invocationAudit.details: Uses the shared Gemini client, capped at three attempts.
These can consume live quota but are not imported by application startup or the test runner. They were inspected and never executed during this incident fix.

safeguards.frontend: Coalesce concurrent progress fetches; guard actions synchronously; poll only active jobs; stop automatic polling on error; expose explicit Refresh progress.
safeguards.uploads: Separate Choose files, Upload files and Generate report. Show selected, partially uploaded and uploaded states per filename. Recover server-confirmed uploads even after IndexedDB is cleared. Retry only unsaved excerpts. Existing content hashes prevent duplicate imports. Persist original filenames with passages through the existing extras mapping.
safeguards.generation: Existing durable input/source hashes reuse identical jobs, including completed work; regeneration has a per-question identity; per-course job exclusion and synchronous frontend guards prevent concurrent duplicate authoring work.
safeguards.requestBudgets: Persisted j.calls and j.requestBudget apply across retries, verification and manual resumes. Generation: 18 provider attempts per job. Recommendations: 3. Analysis: min(600, sourceGroupCount * 6 + 12). Existing resume-attempt limit of five remains. Budgets are assigned before the first provider call and old call counts are retained.
safeguards.transport: Clamp finite transport attempts to whole numbers from 1 to 3; invalid/infinite values use 3. Persist accounting before inference. Budget/accounting rejection is nonretryable and marked not_sent in the quota ledger.
safeguards.auditability: New authoring quota entries include jobId, courseId and kind. Shared RPM/TPM/RPD safeguards remain.

verification.networkPolicy: Node test preload clears Gemini/Supabase configuration and blocks external fetches. Gemini transport tests inject mock fetch implementations. Browser tests use in-memory stores, injected authoring providers, ephemeral ports and installed Edge. The user's application was never restarted.
verification.focusedTests: 22 passed: job budgets, retries, duplicate submissions/resumes, zero-inference saves/fetches, persisted upload metadata, recovery, source grounding and generation.
verification.regression: 149 passed, 1 existing skip; includes local PGlite persistence, Question Bank, versioning, grading and Game.
verification.browser: 14 tests covering the existing screens and the expanded authoring/upload workflows.

limitations: Existing deployment assumes one application process and persistent disk; no cross-process job or quota lock was introduced.
New lifetime budgets may leave unusually difficult jobs partially complete; checkpoints and drafts remain available and budget exhaustion does not automatically start replacement work.
Other consumers of the same Google project are invisible to the local ledger. Historical reservations are not a provider billing audit.
Live Supabase and live Gemini were not exercised.
